correctness.rationale: The arbitrary-characteristic embedding-to-symmetric-factor correspondence is proved directly from natural-basis products and a projection to an envelope. Every possible normalized rank-one linear form over F_2 and F_3 is considered; quotient rank >3 is a proven impossibility for seven-term coverage, while all 1 and 2355 surviving subsets respectively fail exact containment. The eight-term matrices, injectivity, and all 256 and 6561 algebra products are verified by the embedded independent finite-field arithmetic code. No extrapolation beyond the finite domain is asserted.

value.rationale: Costoya et al. explicitly single out the F_3,n=4 strict-gap case without its exact number. The minimal envelope dimension is an intrinsic and motivated algebra invariant controlling smallest graph-like natural-basis realizations; exact attainment at eight, plus a first characteristic-two counterpart where Waring squaring loses multiplication information, resolves two natural finite-field boundary cases. The exact values can be used to calibrate the field-dependent limits of general evolution-embedding theorems; no downstream general theorem is claimed.
